method: CABAL v2.0: every supported broad spot asset reaches execution analysis; Stage-A/top-30 never gates execution. One canonical engine emits WATCH or BUY_NOW. Protective stops prefer the freshest executable 15m support. NTFY relays/revalidates rather than re-scoring. Manual SPOT only.
